_readme: Tasks are single minigame steps at one station. Jobs are customer tickets. price = labor from a real shop price list (see stats.json / sources.md); the customer also pays retail for parts used (partsUse x parts point value). Torque targets are typical values for gameplay, not manufacturer specs: always use the component manual.
